title: Generic RingBuffer<T, N> for IMU history
hints: Store `head_` (index of the oldest element) and `size_`. The logical element i is `buf_[(head_ + i) % N]`.
push when full: overwrite `buf_[head_]` (the oldest) and advance `head_ = (head_ + 1) % N`. When not full, write at `(head_ + size_) % N` and ++size_.
push(T&&) must `std::move(v)` into the slot so move-only types (unique_ptr) work. pop: `T out = std::move(buf_[head_]); ...; return out;`.
average: `T acc{}; for (i < size) acc = acc + rb[i]; return acc / static_cast<double>(rb.size());` (or T{} if empty).
